too-many-resets: Arịrịọ ịtọgharị okwuntughe dị ọtụtụ. Biko chere nkeji ole na ole wee nwaa ọzọ.
too-many-email-links: A rịọrọ email dị ọtụtụ. Biko chere nkeji ole na ole wee nwaa ọzọ.

too-many-tokens: A nwalere token nnweta dị ọtụtụ na-anaghị arụ ọrụ site n'adreesị a. Biko chere nkeji ole na ole wee nwaa ọzọ.

too-many-deletes: Token nnweta a ebugala ndekọ dị ọtụtụ n'ebe mkpofu n'ime otu awa gara aga. Biko nwaa ọzọ mgbe e mesịrị.
too-many-changes: E mere mgbanwe dị ọtụtụ n'akaụntụ a site na token nnweta. Biko chere ntakịrị oge wee nwaa ọzọ; mgbanwe na weebụsaịtị ka na-arụ ọrụ.
too-many-mcp: Arịrịọ dị ọtụtụ na ngwaọrụ Glazecalc maka ndị inyeaka AI. Biko chere nkeji ole na ole wee nwaa ọzọ.
too-many-oauth: Arịrịọ ijikọ ngwa dị ọtụtụ si n'adreesị a. Biko chere nkeji ole na ole wee nwaa ọzọ.
too-many-registrations: Ngwa dị ọtụtụ debanyere onwe ha aha. Biko nwaa ọzọ mgbe e mesịrị.
too-many-imports: Mbubata dị ọtụtụ n'akaụntụ a n'ime otu awa gara aga. Biko nwaa ọzọ mgbe e mesịrị.
